map.不等于直接停产。本表是自评工具，触发的是内部整改流程；真正责令停产由应急管理部门: It does not mean an immediate production halt. This sheet is a self-audit tool that triggers an internal corrective process; an actual ordered shutdown is decided by the emergency management authority under the law. But if the sheet flags items such as "special operations without certification" or "major hazards not rectified", regulations require immediate stop-work and rectification, and working with known hazards is not allowed. Link the scores to the hazard ledger and escalate major items immediately.
map.企业 HSE 管理体系年度自评：按 10 项（安全培训档案、特种作业持证、PPE: Annual self-assessment of a company HSE management system: score the 10 items (safety training records, special operations certification, PPE provision and use, hazard identification, emergency drill plans, safety inspection records, environmental protection measures, occupational health checks, accident reporting system, safety culture), locate weak spots and make an improvement plan.
map.安全生产标准化达标创建：对照评分找差距（如补职业健康体检、完善应急演练），支撑标: Safe production standardisation: compare against the scoring to find gaps (such as adding occupational health checks and improving emergency drills), supporting standardisation grading applications.

map.无实质区别，只是词序习惯：中国企业多称 HSE（Health、Safety、En: No substantive difference, just word order habit: Chinese companies usually say HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) and some European systems say EHS (Environment, Health, Safety); the health, safety and environment content covered is identical. This tool uses HSE per domestic convention, which does not affect the check items or scoring logic.

map.评分「不合格」是否等于必须停产？: Does a "fail" score mean production must stop?
map.：10 项评分取：[符合,部分符合,部分符合,部分符合,部分符合,部分符合,部分: : the 10 items score [compliant, partly, partly, partly, partly, partly, partly, partly, compliant, partly], giving 2/1/1/1/1/1/1/1/2/1 for a total of 12. Pass rate=12÷20×100%=60%. Grading: >=18 excellent, >=14 good, >=10 average, <10 fail. This case at 12 is "average" and the tool reports "there are safety hazards; rectify within a deadline and strengthen training and inspection frequency". Weak items concentrate in items 2-8 (special operations certification, PPE, hazard identification, emergency drills, inspection records, environmental protection and occupational health are all partly compliant) and should be the next rectification focus, with the missing special operations certification being a major hazard requiring immediate action.
